entries.title: LAY'S Heartwork Microinfluencer Report - Heartwork Packs - 18.09.2020
entries.content:
LAY’S #HEARTWORK PACKS TO MICRO INFLUENCERS
1st July – 14th September 2020

THE BRIEF
Building on the connect formed with close to 1500 micro-influencers from the Smile campaign, LAY’S continued the trend by introducing LAY’S #Heartwork special packs to the extended LAY’S family securing reach, awareness, engagement and brand love.

Furthermore, the idea was to ensure every corner of India learnt of the LAY’S #Heartwork campaign through multiple social media posts that showered gratitude and drove donations for the unsung heroes of the country – farmers, truck drivers, retailers and many more.

OUR APPROACH
3 box & cotton pack types
Designing + printing
Buying lays packs
INR 20 pack
Special note as per pack type
Designing + printing
Corrugated box
To protect the box
Courier
All India Under Covid19 lockdown
Coordinating with the influencers
Calling to ensure messaging comes across

On connecting with the overall database of influencers we saw immense interest to participate in the campaign.
We connected with each of them individually and briefed them on the LAY’S #Heartwork Campaign and urged them to spread the word on their social media pages.

Alongside the outreach, we worked on preparing over 1000 LAY’S Heartwork boxes with customized letters and LAY’S Heartwork packs for each influencer, which was then shipped to their personal address amid a partial lockdown.
After the deliveries were made, we individually connected with each of them for feedback.

PHASE 1
1st July – 20th August
Total Packs Sent: 900
Promised Engagement: 700
Total Influencers engaged: 737
Posts Done: 587
Stories Done: 506

PHASE 2
20th August – 14th September
Total Packs Sent: 500
Promised Engagement: N/A
Total Influencers engaged: 321
Posts Done: 266
Stories Done: 379

TOTAL
Total Packs Sent: 1400
Total Influencers engaged: 1058
Posts Done: 853
Stories Done: 885

RESULTS
Tracked as per listening tool (excludes stories without hashtag/brand handle).
Reached out to 1400 influencers for the activity.
75% of the influencers organically posted on Instagram – 1058 influencers.
On an average each Influencer did 1 Instagram post & 3-4 Instagram stories.

CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE SUMMARY
ENGAGEMENT: 3.81 M
REACH: 4.76 M
MICRO INFLUENCERS: 1058 activated
POSTS/VIDEOS: 1738 (posts + stories)
Total Activity Duration: 1st July – 14th September 2020
Tracked as per listening tool (excludes stories without hashtag/brand handle).

CAMPAIGN PERCEIVED VALUE & COST SAVING
Perceived total amount: INR 1,58,72,000.
By doing Barter campaigns brand spent INR 14 Lakhs all inclusive.
Compared with the perceived value of INR 158 Lakhs.
Saving done by the brand: INR 1.44 Crore.

KEY LEARNINGS AND TAKEAWAYS
What Worked:
All influencers loved the campaign thought and appreciated how LAY’S urged other brands to thank the unsung heroes.
Influencers were elated to receive a repost from the brand handle.
Corrugated boxes helped provide extra protection during mass delivery.
Everyone followed the brief & tagged & thanked people personally as well.
Lot of fan engagement came and phase 2 was done out of sheer demand.

What Didn’t Work:
Influencers were slightly unclear about the cotton packs. Would recommend printing - DO NOT OPEN at the back of the pack.
Couriers were delayed under lockdown in certain areas.
Under COVID19 social distancing packaging teams had to work overtime.
Influencers who didn’t post wanted more than 1 pack of chips in the barter or wanted a payment for their post.

entries.title: Lay’s Heartwork x Reels Brief 22 July 2020
entries.content:
Lay’s Heartwork x Reels Brief | 22 July 2020

Idea
We launched our #Heartwork campaign to thank our unsung heroes such as farmers, factory workers, delivery people, shopkeepers and more who work tirelessly to bring us joy. We also thanked the Heartworkers of other brands on Twitter and Instagram, who are doing #Heartwork to make moments of joy possible.

Through Reels, we want people to express their gratitude towards the Heartworkers of their choice through our #Heartwork anthem. We’ll upload original music clips of our Heartwork anthem and #Heartwork stickers which will be used to create interesting content thanking the Heartworkers.

Mandates
Use campaign hashtags including #LaysIndia and #Heartwork and tag @lays_india.
Record performance in apparel matching the brand colour yellow.
Do not use hate symbols or political or religious references.
No competitor brand should be visible in frame.
Do not trivialize the contribution of those doing #Heartwork.
Choose one or more professions and thank their workers through the performance.

Creative Directions
The Heartwork Dance: enact actions of the Heartworker being thanked and include the heart symbol made with hands.
Lip Sync: expressive performance; additional actors may be used.
Acting It Out: a simple set thanking Heartworkers can be explored.
Creators were free to develop concepts as long as they followed the mandates.

OUR APPROACH

RESULTS IN THIS RETROSPECTIVE VERSION
Total packs sent: 1400
Total influencers who posted: 1058
Posts done: 853
Stories done: 3528
75% of influencers organically posted on Instagram
No. of followers of influencers: 22 Million
Reach: 40% = 8.8 Million
Micro influencers: 1058 participated – 75% conversion
Posts/videos: 4381 (posts + stories)
Engagement: 3.83 M
The report states all posts were made organically and that over 50 macro influencers also participated.

KEY LEARNINGS
All influencers loved the campaign thought and appreciated how LAY’S urged other brands to thank the unsung heroes.
Influencers were elated to receive a repost from the brand handle.
Corrugated boxes helped protect packs during mass delivery.
Phase 2 was done out of demand.
Courier delays and social-distancing packaging constraints were noted.
